name: levodopa-assist
description: Frontend Vite + backend Express (local y Vercel Services)

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix webapp/backend && npm install --prefix webapp/frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix webapp/backend" "npm run dev --prefix webapp/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run build:frontend
